gnss-interference-monitor.group: GNSS threats: detect, map, locate, authenticate
gnss-interference-monitor.shows: Per-receiver scorer for jamming, spoofing, slow drag-off, clock drift and lost fix from u-blox telemetry; latched alarm with reasons; ADS-B NACp area map
gnss-interference-monitor.key_result: [Synthetic drag](README.md#run-verified-part): static-reference mode flags a 0.02 m/s^2 drag at 38 s / 14 m; 20 h synthetic soak 0 alert epochs (CV prior). On GNSS-SDR output of simulated IQ the drag-off is caught 6-9 s after it starts

gnss-signal-chain.group: GNSS threats: detect, map, locate, authenticate
gnss-signal-chain.shows: File-only GPS L1 IQ chain: gps-sdr-sim => spoof/jam mixer => GNSS-SDR => scorer, four scenarios
gnss-signal-chain.key_result: [Drag-off](README.md#before--after): alert at t=89 s (CV prior) / t=86 s (static reference), 9 / 6 s after the drag starts; clean run 0 alarm epochs

jammer-sensor-network.group: GNSS threats: detect, map, locate, authenticate
jammer-sensor-network.shows: Many cheap receivers report C/N0 drop and AGC; aggregator localizes the jammer (centroid, RSS least squares, grid Bayes, optional DF) => CoT + navdash
jammer-sensor-network.key_result: [16 nodes on 4 x 4 km, 6 dB shadowing](README.md#monte-carlo-evaluatepy-40-trials-per-row-one-10-s-snapshot-of-static-nodes): grid median 313 m, grid + 3 DF stations 40 m (40 trials)

interference-geolocation-to-tak.group: GNSS threats: detect, map, locate, authenticate
interference-geolocation-to-tak.shows: Jammer triangulation from KrakenSDR-style DF bearings (stdlib RANSAC + Gauss-Newton, Stone Soup PF/UKF) => CoT point + 95 % ellipse
interference-geolocation-to-tak.key_result: [3 stations, 300 s](README.md#run-all-of-this-was-run-on-2026-11-06): 14 m (ls), 12 m (pf), 8 m (ukf); truth inside the 95 % ellipse in every run (one seed)

gnss-rinex-processing.group: GNSS threats: detect, map, locate, authenticate
gnss-rinex-processing.shows: RTKLIB demo5 SPP/RTK and gnss_lib_py WLS on public NOAA CORS RINEX, scored against the NGS coordinate
gnss-rinex-processing.key_result: [RTK](README.md#observed-results-2026-11-06) 0.084 / 0.055 / 0.071 m E/N/U rms, 97 % fix; SPP 0.62 / 1.24 / 1.02 m

golden-demo.group: Integrity and GNSS-loss response on a vehicle
golden-demo.shows: ArduCopter SITL survey, GPS dragged (position or coherent); companion detects with SS + velocity test against real geoloc, switches EKF3 to ExternalNav; dashboard replay; 52-flight Monte Carlo
golden-demo.key_result: [52 flights](README.md#v2-monte-carlo-ran-2026-11-06-52-flights): 24/24 monitor flights detected, 0/4 false alarms without spoof; coherent 1 m/s median TTD 2.8 s; max deviation 5.4-18.6 m (one 29.1 m) vs 24.5-86.9 m without the monitor

altpnt-integrity.group: Integrity and GNSS-loss response on a vehicle
altpnt-integrity.shows: Stdlib EKF (INS + VIO + visual geoloc + jammed then spoofed GNSS) with solution-separation FDE, protection level, MI/HMI, Stanford diagram; v2 recalibrates every error model on measured sibling-sample data
altpnt-integrity.runtime: v1 ~20 s (20 seeds); v2 Monte Carlo ~3 min
altpnt-integrity.key_result: [v2, 20 seeds, AL 50 m](README.md#3-monte-carlo-python3-altpnt_v2py---runs-20-182-s-resultsv2_mcjson): with error models measured on real runs, the v1 monitor goes from 0 to 8901 of 12 000 MI* epochs; v2 (heading/scale states + measured R) gets back to 0 MI* at 13-26 % availability (34-41 % at AL 100 m). v1's 0 MI at 41.7 % holds only under its own assumed noise ([why](README.md#4-what-changed-vs-v1-honestly))

gnss-ins-ekf-outage.group: Integrity and GNSS-loss response on a vehicle
gnss-ins-ekf-outage.shows: 2D loosely coupled GNSS/INS EKF: INS-only drift, 60 s outage, spoof walk-off vs gate and latch
gnss-ins-ekf-outage.key_result: [60 s outage](README.md#expected-output-observed-python3147-2026-11-06): EKF max 7.7 m vs INS-only 1303.8 m; the gate never alarms on drags up to 0.5 m/s

ardupilot-ekf3-source-switch.group: Integrity and GNSS-loss response on a vehicle
ardupilot-ekf3-source-switch.shows: EKF3 source-set switch to ExternalNav (SITL vicon) around a GPS cut, plus a no-switch contrast run
ardupilot-ekf3-source-switch.key_result: [With switch](README.md#run-the-sitl-flight-ran-2026-11-06): POS_HORIZ_ABS kept 30 s without GPS; [without](README.md#contrast-run-gps-cut-without-the-source-switch): ~6 s coast, then EKF failsafe LAND

visual-geolocalization-lightglue.shows: Nadir frame => orthophoto match (LightGlue, MAGSAC homography, GeoTIFF transform) => lat/lon; stdlib geometry module
visual-geolocalization-lightglue.key_result: [Synthetic pairs from one real ortho](README.md#run): 0.04-0.21 m; 30.67 m wrong fix accepted at the ortho edge

geoloc-license-clean.shows: Same pipeline with permissive parts only (ALIKED / DISK / SIFT + LightGlue, NAIP maps), synthetic and real eBee frames
geoloc-license-clean.key_result: [Synthetic](README.md#measured-results-ran-2026-11-06) same-map 0.10-0.11 m, cross-season 1.90-4.82 m median; real eBee frames 1 of 5 fixed (11.0 m)

terrain-relative-nav-pf.shows: Stdlib SIR particle filter: biased INS + radar altimeter vs a synthetic DEM, flat-terrain control
terrain-relative-nav-pf.key_result: [Seed 7](README.md#observed-output-python3147-2026-11-06): PF 4-25 m vs INS 380.3 m at 200 s; flat control 1-sigma 229-301 m

blind-flight-bench.shows: Benchmark for the 2026 Blind flight brief: 20 km radar-altimeter flights over four real GLO-30 windows, 10 navigators incl. clean-room team re-implementations
blind-flight-bench.key_result: [Straight, 20 km](README.md#straight-flights-all-regions-pooled): beam-aware PF 148 m median (18 % diverged) vs dead reckoning 1582 m (92 %); turns: every navigator diverges in 80-100 % of flights

magnav-quickstart.shows: MagNav.jl Tolles-Lawson + EKF on real SGL 2020 flight line 1006.08
magnav-quickstart.key_result: [One 14 min line](README.md#observed-output-2026-11-06): EKF DRMS 31.2 m vs INS-only final 218.8 m; CRLB DRMS 13 m

relative-nav-benchmark.shows: KISS-ICP, OpenVINS, mono and nadir VO on KITTI 04, UZH-FPV and VPAIR, scored with evo; fitted error models fed to altpnt-integrity
relative-nav-benchmark.runtime: lidar 12-20 s + 1.13 GB; OpenVINS image ~20 min
relative-nav-benchmark.key_result: [Final drift](README.md#results): KISS-ICP 0.12 % of 394 m; OpenVINS 0.26 % of 278 m; nadir VO 15.5 % image-only, 0.65 % attitude-aided over 8.98 km

vio-to-mavlink-bridge.shows: ENU/FLU pose => NED/FRD ODOMETRY or VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE for EKF3 / EKF2
vio-to-mavlink-bridge.key_result: [EKF3](README.md#ardupilot-arducopter-copter-463-sitl) and [EKF2](README.md#px4-v1170-sih-quadrotor) fused a stationary ODOMETRY pose; no flight on vision

mavlink-to-tak-cot.shows: MAVLink GLOBAL_POSITION_INT => CoT; stdlib builder plus pymavlink/PyTAK bridge
mavlink-to-tak-cot.key_result: [Offline end to end](README.md#part-2---bridge-offline-end-to-end-verified): well-formed CoT at ~1 Hz over TCP and UDP to a local sink (fake autopilot)

stone-soup-tracking.shows: Stone Soup EKF + JPDA on two simulated UAVs in radar clutter, OSPA vs truth
stone-soup-tracking.key_result: [One seed](README.md#observed-output-stonesoup-191-python-31214-2026-11-06): 2 tracks on 2 truths, OSPA mean 17.0 m, max 53.0 m (c = 100 m)

remote-id-to-tak.shows: Stdlib Open Drone ID decoder validated against opendroneid-core-c, track table with plausibility flags, CoT via PyTAK
remote-id-to-tak.key_result: [Decoder](README.md#1-decoder-validated-against-opendroneid-core-c-ran-it) field-for-field equal to core-c on 500 + 500 vectors and 81 payloads from public captures

usv-gnss-denied-nav.shows: USV own-ship nav in the Oresund: compass + speed-log DR, simulated radar matched to the real OSM chart, monitor excludes spoofed GNSS
usv-gnss-denied-nav.key_result: [5 seeds](README.md#results-5-seeds-real-outputs): coastal drag excluded 125-131 s after onset, max error 10-25 m vs 1391-1395 m without the monitor; 0 false alarms in 25 runs

maritime-ais-spoofing.shows: Stdlib detectors for spoofing signatures in real Danish AIS; recall and TTD on injected episodes; GeoJSON + CoT
maritime-ais-spoofing.key_result: [Injected episodes](README.md#results-on-injected-episodes-all-ran-2026-11-06): recall 0.79 (tuning day), 0.75 (held-out day), median TTD 7-8 s; no real spoofing found in 8.8 h

dismounted-foot-ins.shows: Stdlib 15-state ZUPT EKF on 36 real pyshoe trials, cross-checked with pyshoe; corridor heading, floor, simulated UWB; CoT/navdash
dismounted-foot-ins.key_result: [36 trials](README.md#result-1-stdlib-filter-vs-pyshoe-shoe-g--85e7-w--5-all-36-trials): 2.35 m ARMSE, 1.30 % final error (pyshoe 2.51 m, 1.49 %) on the author's download (re-run 2026-11-06: identical); a fresh download in review round 2 gave 2.21 m / 1.33 %, cause not found. The 95 % radius covers the truth at only 31 % of markers (60 % with ins15_py_yrw). [Aided](README.md#result-3-aiding-ins15_py--shoe-85e7-all-36-trials) 1.07 m, 0.83 % (UWB simulated)

swarm-coop-localization.shows: 6 vehicles, 2 with GNSS, UWB ranging: centralized EKF vs covariance intersection, robust ranging, spoofed-anchor detection
swarm-coop-localization.key_result: [10 seeds](README.md#results-10-seeds): central robust team RMSE 2.0 m vs dead reckoning 49.1 m; solution separation detects the spoofed anchor in 9/10 with 1 false alarm

timing-holdover.shows: GNSS-disciplined oscillator sim (TCXO / CSAC / OCXO / Rb): holdover error after outage, slow time-walk spoof vs internal and cross-source monitors
timing-holdover.key_result: [24 h holdover](README.md#output-ran-on-2026-11-06-python-3147-default-arguments-about-5-s), median: TCXO 59.58 us, CSAC 1.27 us, OCXO 610.0 ns, Rb 43.8 ns (no temperature term)

llm-agent-usage.shows: The hub's stdlib MCP server (search / show / concept / neighbors) piped a demo session; client registration snippets
llm-agent-usage.key_result: [Demo session](README.md): 7 JSON-RPC responses (functional check, no metric)

llm-mission-agent.shows: Safety-gated MAVLink MCP server (geofence, altitude band, mode allowlist, dry run) flying ArduCopter SITL; Claude tool-use loop included but not run
llm-mission-agent.key_result: [Scripted MCP client](README.md#what-was-verified-2026-11-06): takeoff, survey upload, GPS loss => degraded health => ExternalNav switch => RTL; fence and altitude rejections fired

sitl-docker.shows: Headless ArduCopter 4.6.3 SITL and PX4 v1.17.0 SIH images, compose file, client image
sitl-docker.key_result: [Images](README.md#what-was-verified-2026-11-06-docker-2952-apple-silicon-linuxarm64): ArduPilot 1.85 GB, PX4 214 MB, client 558 MB; both stacks flew the other samples
